title: The central role of the coach in college football dominates Google searches
seoTitle: Coach's role in college football tops Google searches
subtitle: With the looming rematch between Texas and Ohio State, the head coach becomes the focal point in college sports.
excerpt: College football is buzzing with the highly anticipated showdown between the Buckeyes and the Longhorns, spotlighting coaches' strategies and leadership.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The universe of college football is in a frenzy, and with it, the figure of the "coach" rises as one of the most searched terms. This phenomenon is largely due to the imminent and awaited rematch between No. 1 Ohio State and No. 5 Texas, a clash that places the strategies and leadership of the coaches at the center of attention.

The clash of giants and their strategists

This Saturday, Ohio State will become the first No. 1 team to visit Austin since Alabama in 2022, marking only the sixth historic meeting between the Buckeyes and the Longhorns. The game is viewed as a playoff-caliber event, as highlighted by player Hero Kanu, who has played for both teams. The rivalry is intense, and the outcome could have significant implications for both programs’ seasons, putting the coaches under immense pressure and visibility.

The pressure on Steve Sarkisian

The Longhorns’ head coach, Steve Sarkisian, faces a considerable challenge. After two consecutive losses to the Buckeyes in the 2024 and 2025 seasons, Texas seeks redemption. The 2025 loss, in particular, was critical, preventing the team from reaching the playoffs despite a strong finish. Sarkisian, however, remains focused on the present: "I don't need to spend so much energy and time on what this game means. As a competitor, we have the chance to play against the No. 1 team in the country, a team we've battled twice in the last two years." He emphasizes that there are still "10 more games to play" to determine the season’s final outcome.

Recent history and the quest for redemption

Previous matchups were marked by decisive moments. In 2024, Texas was about to tie in the final moments of the fourth quarter when Ohio State’s Jack Sawyer recovered a fumble and ran 83 yards for a touchdown, sealing the Buckeyes’ victory. In the last season, in Columbus, Ohio State won 14-7, a game that practically ended Arch Manning’s Heisman campaign for Texas and launched Julian Sayin’s for Ohio State. Kanu, who played on both sides of the rivalry, acknowledges the intensity: "They dominated the better moments more than we did last year." These past experiences intensify the focus on coaches’ decisions and preparation for the current showdown.

Other names highlighted in the scene

In addition to Sarkisian, other coaches are also mentioned in the context of college football. For example, Schiano commented that Rutgers was a "joke" after losing to the underdog UMass. These statements underscore the constant evaluation and pressure that fall on coaches, not only in high-profile games but in all competitions. The responsibility of leading the teams, both in victories and defeats, and managing fans’ and media expectations, is a constant in these professionals’ careers.

With information from AP News.
